subject: Request to keep pilot live — procurement audit delaying PO
messages:
From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@cardinalai.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cardinalai.com
Date: 2026-08-15T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Pilot access expiry — procurement audit delaying PO

Hi Monica,

Quick note from procurement — we ran into an internal audit on the vendor onboarding for CardinalAI and our PO approval has been paused. The team has been loving the pilot (especially the end-to-end NER runs), but the account is scheduled to auto-expire in 48 hours which would interrupt our evaluation.

Is there any way Redwood can keep our sandbox live for an extra week while procurement finishes the audit? We can share the draft PO (attached) and expect approvals within 7–10 business days.

Appreciate any runway you can provide — the pilot is feeding directly into our next sprint and losing continuity would be costly.

Best,
Sara Lin
Head of Data Science
CardinalAI Solutions

Attachment: PO_draft_cardinalai.pdf (pdf, 412 KB)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@cardinalai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T11:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Pilot access expiry — procurement audit delaying PO

Hi Sara — thanks for the heads up and for sending the draft PO.

We can absolutely keep the pilot live while your procurement wraps up. Two options to preserve continuity:

- Temporary 7-day extension on the current pilot window (no charge), OR
- 5k token promotional credit applied immediately to keep longer-running tests active and avoid quota throttles.

Can you confirm which you prefer? Also: roughly when do you anticipate final sign-off (best estimate is fine). I have looped Ben (sales lead) and David (finance) to fast-track the approval on our side.

If you choose the credit, I can issue it today and send setup steps.

Thanks,
Monica
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T11:10:00-04:00
Subject: Internal: Approve short-term pilot runway for CardinalAI (RDW-2026-0057)

Ben / David —

Customer: CardinalAI Solutions (Sara Lin). Procurement hit an audit and their PO is paused; pilot expires in ~48 hours. They asked for 7–10 business days runway.

Proposal: issue a 7-day free extension OR apply a 5,000-token promotional credit today to keep their environment active. This is a low-dollar, high-significance move — win probability high, go-live target mid-September.

Budget/impact: 5k tokens ~ equivalent to ~$35 of committed usage at current SR. Requesting approval to grant the extension/credit conditionally (require PO or signed SOW within 14 days).

Related hubspot/deal: https://app.hubspot.com/record/12345?deal=RDW-2026-0057

Are we good to proceed? I can draft the external note and apply the credit if Ben signs off.

Thanks,
Monica

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T14:22:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Approve short-term pilot runway for CardinalAI (RDW-2026-0057)

LGTM. Approve the 5k token credit today and include the PO-within-14-days condition in the note. If PO doesn't arrive in 14 days, we revoke the credit and pause the account.

David — flagging for finance monitoring; no invoice write-off required if PO arrives.

Ben
Director, Commercial Sales

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@cardinalai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, procurement@cardinalai.com
Date: 2026-08-17T16:45:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Pilot access expiry — procurement audit delaying PO

Hi Sara — quick update and confirmation:

We applied a 5,000-token promotional credit to your sandbox environment just now to keep everything running (you should see the credit applied in the admin console). This credit is conditional on CardinalAI closing the PO or signing an SOW within 14 days from today (RDW-2026-0057). If PO/SOW isn't received by 2026-08-31 we will need to pause the pilot.

Next steps:
- Verify you can run your end-to-end tests this afternoon (ping me if anything looks wrong).
- Please share the expected PO date when you have it — procurement@cardinalai.com is on the thread.

I've attached brief setup notes and the temporary access instructions.

Thanks for the quick coordination — glad we could keep the momentum.

Best,
Monica
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: temporary_access_instructions.pdf (pdf, 48 KB)
